items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: I told Dr. Sushaw on that too. I don't like it. I don't like that music. He said, you don't. I said, no, I don't like it, doctor.

ctx.x: And then you're my own and all the same. Same way. Ain't no different about it. I never heard nobody play. You're better. I never heard nobody play a cornet time like that. Never. None of them. Almerico, Ossantos, Shockey. Oh, Shockey. Oh. I had Shockey a few times.
I told Dr. Sushaw on that too. I don't like it. I don't like that music. He said, you don't. I said, no, I don't like it, doctor. I don't like it. I don't like that music.

He said, you don't. I said, no, I don't like it, doctor. I don't like it. I said, I don't know what kind of time they play, but I don't like it. I said, I really don't like it. Have you played with Johnny Lala?
